definitions: Make a visible impression or a stain on (something).
Write or draw a symbol, sign, or word on (something).
Indicate (a position or boundary) by making a mark.
Assign a score or grade to (a piece of work).
Be a characteristic or distinguishing feature of.
examples: She marked the correct answer with a tick.
They marked the boundary with flags.
His kindness marked him out from the others.
Mark my words, he'll regret it.
